description: This Kotlin source file defines a utility for monitoring the device's current timezone. It implements an interface 'TimeZoneMonitor' that exposes a flow of timezone updates, primarily using Android's BroadcastReceiver to listen for timezone change events. The class 'TimeZoneBroadcastMonitor' manages registration and unregistration of the receiver, emitting timezone changes into a shared flow and applying flow operators to optimize emissions.

classes.name: TimeZoneBroadcastMonitor
classes.description: A singleton class that implements TimeZoneMonitor, registers a BroadcastReceiver to listen for timezone changes, and exposes a flow of TimeZone objects reflecting the current timezone, updating reactively as changes occur.

methods.name: TimeZoneBroadcastMonitor.currentTimeZone
methods.description: Provides a shared flow emitting timezone updates, starting with the default timezone and updating upon timezone change events.
